info.title: QorgauAI — AntiFraud Sentinel KZ
info.description: AI digital-immunity platform against internet fraud in Kazakhstan. Bearer JWT for user endpoints; X-Api-Key for the partner tier.

post.summary: Pre-transfer check: should the app make the user pause before paying a new payee?
Post-incident action checklist for the first 60 minutes (KZ/RU/EN).

get.summary: Catalogue of common KZ schemes with an example, signs and what to do (ru/kk/en).

post.summary: Operator confirms the signed contract: the partner can issue live keys.
Report a suspicious number / link / IBAN / listing. Idempotent via 'Idempotency-Key'.

get.summary: Public feed of recent community reports (masked, no reporter identity).
Public 'is this a scam?' check for a phone number or IBAN. Partner-friendly.
League by points (optionally per region). Names only for people who opted in; restricted minors are never listed.
Public integrity status of the hash-chained decision log (no entry contents).

post.summary: Create a citizen account with a password (data-minimising: phone kept only as a hash). Requires explicit policy consent.
Sign in with e-mail and password. 5 wrong passwords lock the account for 15 minutes (429 + Retry-After).
E-mails a single-use reset link (30 min). Always 202 — never reveals whether the account exists.
Sets a new password from a reset link and signs the account out everywhere.
Rotate a refresh token. A replayed (already used) token revokes the whole session family.
Revoke the session the given refresh token belongs to. Idempotent.
[Development only] Issue a JWT for a seeded user — for demoing protected endpoints.

get.summary: Current consent state per scope, plus whether the user accepted the current policy version.

put.summary: Grant or withdraw one consent. Stores policy version + salted IP hash as evidence.

post.summary: Machine-readable copy of everything stored about the caller (right of access / portability).

get.summary: Whether an account deletion is scheduled, and when it becomes irreversible.

post.summary: Schedule account deletion. 14-day grace period, then PII is irreversibly anonymised.

delete.summary: Cancel a pending deletion during the grace period.

post.summary: Change (or, for an account without one, set) the password. Needs the current password; other devices are signed out.

get.summary: Signed-in devices (one per refresh-token family).

delete.summary: Sign a device out by revoking its refresh-token family.

get.summary: Public B2B tariffs: price per request, packs, VAT, limits and overage behaviour. No hidden fees.

post.summary: Analyse a message or link for fraud indicators (heuristics + Gemini + community).
Analyse a chat / listing screenshot (multimodal Gemini vision + OCR).
Analyse a call / voice-message recording, incl. AI-deepfake indicators.

get.summary: Fetch a past assessment with its full explainability breakdown.

post.summary: Flag a verdict as wrong — routes it to human review (Explainable AI / HITL).
Unshorten a link (no page rendering, SSRF-guarded), detect typosquatting / IDN homographs of KZ brands, then score it.
Decode a QR code from a photo (ZXing) and scan its link like any URL. The image is not sent to the AI provider.
Register a text check to be streamed via GET /scam-check/{id}/stream (valid 2 minutes, single use).

get.summary: Server-sent events: one 'layer' event per finished layer (heuristics → AI → community), then 'result' or 'failed'.

post.summary: Mark a community report as useful or not. One vote per person; changeable.

get.summary: Report counts per region (17 regions + 3 cities) for the last N days (1–90).
Top schemes of the period vs the previous period (growth / decline).
Public daily aggregates (date × region × category), CC BY 4.0. Cells under 5 reports are suppressed. ?format=csv

post.summary: One-click unsubscribe (RFC 8058). Works with the List-Unsubscribe-Post body; idempotent.

get.summary: Pending reports, the most disputed ("not useful" votes) first.

post.summary: Verify or reject a pending report. Audited.

put.summary: Region / categories to watch and channels (weekly e-mail digest, Web Push). In-app alerts are always on.
Name, track, home region; year + month of birth only (under 18 → limited mode until a guardian approves).

get.summary: My family: members and roles; guardians see protected members' risk band only (with consent).

post.summary: A single-use 8-character code valid 48 h, with the invite link and its QR code.
Join with an invite code. Joining as Protected requires explicit consent to share the risk band with guardians.

delete.summary: Leave (yourself) or remove a member (guardian). Ends band sharing with this family's guardians.

post.summary: A guardian in the same family gives legal-guardian consent for a minor (lifts limited mode).
Panic button: push to every other family member's devices. Audited.
Issue (or return the existing) signed certificate for a completed course.

get.summary: Public QR verification: signature + expiry. Shows only the holder's chosen name and the course.

post.summary: Start a training scam message. Requires the PhishingSimulations consent.
Reported / fell for it / ignored → feedback with the tell-tale signs; updates the resilience ratio.

get.summary: The caller's partner account (empty body when there is none yet).

post.summary: Self-serve signup: creates the account and a sandbox key (shown once).
Issue a sandbox key, or a live key once the contract is approved. The raw key is returned once.
New key now; the old one keeps working for 24 h.

get.summary: Daily live / sandbox calls, high-risk results and billable amount (zero-filled).

put.summary: Public https endpoint only. Returns the signing secret the first time (shown once).

post.summary: Sends a signed ping now and reports the endpoint's answer.

get.summary: Monthly usage statement (not a tax invoice).
Detected fraud rings ('money-mule networks') with confidence + reporter counts.
Neighbourhood of one identifier in the fraud graph (recursive-CTE traversal).

post.summary: Create / rotate the family anti-deepfake safe word. Only a salted hash is stored.
Verify a caller's spoken safe word without ever revealing it. Rate-limited; alerts on repeated failure.

get.summary: List published micro-courses, optionally filtered by learner track.
A course with its ordered lessons + knowledge checks (drives the learning path UI).

post.summary: Record completion of a lesson; updates points, streak and the spaced-repetition schedule.

get.summary: Resilience ratio + vulnerability index for a user (the 2026 best-practice metric).

post.summary: Guardian invites a dependent (elderly parent / teenager). Requires the dependent's acceptance + consent.
Dependent accepts a guardian link and grants the (explicit, revocable) consent scopes.

get.summary: Aggregated vulnerability band a guardian may see — never the raw events.

post.summary: Guardian raises a consented dependent's protection mode (Standard / Heightened / Lockdown).
Embeddable risk check for bank / marketplace / delivery checkout & listing flows. Metered per API key.
Reviewer closes a disputed assessment (human-in-the-loop).

get.summary: Walk the hash-chained audit ledger and report the first broken link, if any.
